decisions.reason: Because the stacking tray disappeared from the website by 2024 despite being launched in 2023, it likely did not gain enough traction or was superseded within the core display range.

Although the customer portal is outside the traditional product range, it supports the firm's one-stop service model, deeper customer collaboration, and stronger information handling, which fits its stated direction.
The packaging display solution clearly fits the core cardboard display business and its 2024 German Packaging Award is a strong market validation.
The quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is close to the established offer and having its own page indicates active commercial commitment in a growing market.
The small cardboard counter display is a natural extension of the firm's narrow but focused retail-display portfolio and remains visibly marketed.
The large freestanding cardboard information display matches the firm's core capabilities in custom in-store presentation and is still prominently presented to customers.
